words.sense: A person who imagines far-reaching future possibilities and may foresee practical ways to create them.
misconceptions: Calling any principled person a predictor of future possibilities.

words.sense: A person guided strongly by principles of how life ought to be, even when practical obstacles arise.
words.connotation: Admiring or gently critical of impracticality.
misconceptions: Assuming a bold invention is necessarily a moral ideal.

semantic_axes.description: A visionary sees a transformative future and ways toward it; an idealist follows cherished principles even when reality makes them difficult.

edges.boundary_rule: A visionary sees a transformative future and ways toward it; an idealist follows cherished principles even when reality makes them difficult.
